m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Who are you to disturb my contemplations? My work is vital. I am searching for rot at the core of Bastion.
There is a spy working against the Shadow Queen. Have you heard the name... Cornelius? Is this... you?
No, I don't think so. You are too... young. Too... fresh. But I'll gut you and read my answers in your entrails!
The Moon's Crown? It was lost at the end of the Old Times, right after the Fall of Bastion.
A brazen young Burrower named Alyssa StarGazer hurt Morganthe and fled with the Moon's Crown to Tyrian Gorge.
Alyssa StarGazer hid in the Winter Halo Caverns. An ancient cave, once home to epic power.
Perhaps she disturbed something in those fathomless depths, for neither she nor the Moon's Crown was ever seen again.
What knowledge did Tymen WhiteFlame have to share? A spy in Bastion? :Tsssk:
Something to discuss at greater length, another time. What did you learn about the Moon's Crown?
The Shadow Queen has not suffered setbacks like these in generations.
Well, not here at the center of her power, at any rate.
How have the Burrowers been able to do so much in so little time? You have heard rumors of a spy in the Umbra Legion?
Who would risk so much for so little hope, hmmm? It raises the question: "Why are you here?"
The Moon's Crown? The ancient seer, Tymen WhiteFlame, who dwells in Bastion, might know. But take care - he is often thorny.
Seek out Tymen WhiteFlame, an ancient seer, in Bastion. Ask him your questions about the Moon's Crown, but expect a thorny reception.
